question: As on February 2024, Nitish Kumar is the 9th time Chief Minister of which state?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Bihar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Nitish Kumar** is an Indian politician and a senior leader of the **Janata Dal (United) Party**.
 
• He has served as the **Chief Minister of Bihar** multiple times, making him one of the longest-serving Chief Ministers of the state.
 
• As of **February 2024**, Nitish Kumar has held the position of Chief Minister of Bih
